grounding_note: 9 of 9 quoted claims were verified against the source text.

claims.claim: Most interviewed practices default to the distributor rep's suggested order.
Most interviewed practices buy from multiple distributors, and none forecast usage from the schedule.
Office managers spend about five hours a week on ordering and reconciliation.
Ordering depends on a single person and spreadsheet.
Distribution is concentrated in two national distributors with their own portals.
DSO consolidation squeezes independent practices on supply prices.
Reported savings come from a small internal sample.
Cairnly has five paying customers at $249 per location per month.
Distributor reps likely have little incentive to optimize practice spend across competitors, which leaves room for a neutral ordering layer.
The CEO has direct dental group operations experience.
